input_messages.content: Hi there! I’d like to make some changes to my upcoming flight. Can you help me with that?
My user ID is liam_khan_2521. I don’t have the reservation ID handy, but the flight is from IAH to SEA on May 23. Let me know if you need any more details to find it.

Thanks for pulling that up! I’d like to move the IAH to SEA flight from May 23 to May 24, and I also want to upgrade all passengers to business class for that segment. Can you let me know if that’s possible and what the cost would be?

Thanks for the options! Could you please pick the best available option for me on May 24 with business class for all three passengers? Yes, I want to proceed with the date change and upgrade for everyone in my group. Please let me know the total extra cost before making any changes.

That’s quite a bit higher than I was hoping for. Is there any way to bring the total extra cost under $1000? Maybe by looking at different flight combinations or options? I really want to make this change, but I need to stay within my budget.

I really want to upgrade all passengers to business class and change the date, so I’m not interested in splitting the group or downgrading any segment. Are there any other ways to get the total extra cost under $1000? Maybe if I also upgrade the return flights to business class, would that make a difference in the pricing? If so, could you check what the total would be for upgrading both the outbound and return flights to business class for all passengers, with the date change to May 24?

That’s still way over my budget. Are there any special promotions, discounts, or alternative routes you can check that might help bring the total extra cost for the date change and business class upgrade closer to $1000? I’m really hoping there’s something you can do to help me out.

If there’s no way to get the total extra cost under $1000 for upgrading all passengers to business class and changing the date, then I’ll have to hold off for now. Thanks for checking all the options for me.
Thank you. I appreciate your help! Have a good day. ###STOP###
